verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Fin API (Fin Agent API, answer-generation and retrieval APIs) and a TypeScript SDK with code snippets. Nothing shows an interactive API reference with runnable or try-it examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Since Fin exposes an API, the axis applies, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
